raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-18 and its rows were appended to the original 02:00 delivery, so raw_transactions holds duplicate copies of the same txn_id (the sample shows identical rows, and batch 13 has 654 rows versus about 340 in a typical batch). silver_transactions copies every raw row, which double-counts the 2026-01-17 transactions and inflates the gold tables. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver, keeping the earliest ingest, should restore one row per transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
